title: Desktop client calls the WCF catalog service over basicHttpBinding (endpoint in App.config)
why: Integration direction: WinForms (user machines) -> WCF service (server). When the service moves to AWS, every installed desktop client needs the new HTTPS endpoint, and the SOAP contract must stay identical (CoreWCF BasicHttpBinding keeps it).
fix: Port the service with CoreWCF (basicHttpBinding is supported), publish it behind an ALB with HTTPS, and ship a desktop configuration update (or a DNS name that is repointed at cut-over).
alt: Keep a stable DNS name so clients do not need reconfiguration
question: How are desktop clients deployed and updated (MSI, ClickOnce, manual), and how many are installed?
